description: Identify what lives at a Polygon PoS address: wallet (EOA, including EIP-7702 delegation) or contract, which token standard it implements (ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155), name and symbol, upgradeable-proxy implementation and admin, smart-wallet proxies, bytecode size, nonce and POL balance. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.
name: polygon_contract_info
